gate.evidence: docs/evidence/54-ai-eval-three-tier-gate-run.log: FAILED criterion 1 (100% valid JSON) - 6/9 test-split cases produced no complete JSON object, the model looping on repetitive phrases and a runaway next_checks list until the token budget ran out before the object could close.

docs/evidence/54-ai-eval-three-tier-gate-run.log: FAILED criterion 3 (correct refusal on every gap/collector-down case) - both refusal-expected cases in the test split (link_flap, route_change) got a confident hypothesis instead of a refusal. A challenger for this profile (IBM Granite 4.2-3B, not this entry's own model) was tried next and fixed to meet all six safety criteria after a schema/prompt change (docs/evidence/56-ai-eval-granite-verbosity-fix-final.log) - still not offered, on a usefulness judgment: 0/9 top-1 cause hits, declined to answer 5 of 9 real-cause cases.

docs/evidence/54-ai-eval-three-tier-gate-run.log: FAILED criterion 3 (correct refusal on every gap/collector-down case) - both refusal-expected cases in the test split (link_flap, route_change) got a confident hypothesis instead of a refusal; also the weakest overall accuracy of the three tiers on this run (1/9 pass, 1/9 top-1) despite being the largest model.
